frame: local metres, origin south-west corner, x east, y north, z up
npy_rows: row 0 is the south edge, index [iy, ix] = [y / cell_m, x / cell_m]
png_rows: row 0 is the north edge, like a map

dose_model.source: MSL RAD, Hassler et al. 2014, Science 343, 1244797: 0.64 mSv/day
dose_model.limits: galactic cosmic rays only; ignores the angular spread of the flux, secondary particles from the ground and solar particle events
dose_model.dose_shelter_png: transparent above 97 % of the open-ground dose, full teal at 70 % and below
